summary: refactor(context-render): address shotgun surgery on lines variable

delivery.outcome: Shotgun surgery on lines removed in context_render.py: all 12 render functions build sections with literal lists, comprehensions and unpacking instead of mutating a lines accumulator; render_markdown_handoff joins composed sections.

architecture.decision: Pure compositional rendering: each section function returns a constructed list; the handoff flattens a list of sections.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket branch; mechanical refactor in one module.
